lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, with the spots within each column spaced roughly equidistantly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular spots, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge runs along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with a light-reflecting superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced spots observed on the lateral flank.
